skill.displayName: Optimize text-to-image prompts for Grok and similar image models, especially for aviation posters, safety campaign visuals, official publicity images, and Chinese-language contest briefs.
skill.summary: Optimize text-to-image prompts for Grok and similar image models. Use when the user wants better image generation prompts, poster prompts, competition-grade...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of grok-image-prompt-optimizer.
- Optimize text-to-image prompts for improved image quality, composition, and thematic accuracy.
- Extract briefs into key scene fields; reduce to a single main visual idea.
- Outputs clear main prompts (in Chinese and English), tailored negative prompts, and quick tweak options.
- Contains detailed heuristics and recipes for aviation, safety campaigns, and poster contests.
- Emphasizes poster-specific constraints and technical-domain guardrails for accuracy and suitability.
